title: Attack Transfer Within Model Families: Do Jailbreaks for Llama-3 Work on Llama-3.x Successors?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if jailbreaks transfer near-perfectly within model families, safety improvements across generations are superficial. This is a strong motivating finding for model providers to address inherited vulnerabilities.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Collect successful jailbreaks from AISafetyLab, test on successor models. Pure inference experiment across model versions. No training needed. Model loading is the main challenge but manageable with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Testing across 3-4 Llama versions plus one other family involves many model loads and inference runs. Per-category transfer rate measurement is well-defined but the number of models strains 30 hours. Could scope to just Llama family.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
